responseDisplayAnalysis.interpretation: These are historical Facebook interface labels. They are not verified attendance, unique people, reach, endorsement, or impact.
responseDisplayAnalysis.displayConflict: Several index cards show 0 Went and 0 Interested while their detail pages show nonzero response labels. Some newer cards also differ arithmetically from detail totals. Both states are preserved; neither is converted into attendance.

sourceRouteAnalysis.interpretation: The event descriptions route to project sites, artist pages, music and video pages, and conceptual references. No independent news article was recovered from this event population.

stakeholderPatterns: Public organizer displays connect Jamie with named co-hosts and collaborators in venue safety, participatory art, recurring meals, and music programming.
The NTER CHNG event identifies Drew Bolton, Jamie Burkart, and Garrett Fuselier together.
The 200th Sunday Dinner event identifies Julia Fredenburg and Jamie Burkart together and routes to a WOW List event page.
Artist and venue links show the event pages operating as distribution infrastructure for collaborators rather than as a record of Jamie-only work.
No NYC Council-member engagement record was identified within the event-page metadata reviewed for this personal and WOW List population.

publicSafety.note: The corpus publishes only public-safe metadata and derived findings. One private event is counted without title, date, URL, event ID, names, response data, or venue. Residential venues and phone numbers visible in historical descriptions are omitted.
